comment: Single source of truth for OrchestKit's CC support window. All other floor declarations derive from this via scripts/stamp-cc-support.mjs, which stamps exactly five files: CLAUDE.md, src/hooks/src/lib/cc-version-matrix.ts (MIN_CC_VERSION + LATEST_KNOWN_CC), src/skills/doctor/references/version-compatibility.md, docs/site/content/docs/troubleshooting/index.mdx, and README.md (badge + prose). NOT stamped, and therefore hand-maintained on every bump: the CI installer pins in .github/workflows/*.yml, the 2.1.x assertions in tests/integration/test-cc-release-watch*.sh, and the tests/fixtures/cc-changelogs/ fixtures. manifests/ork.json was previously listed here as a derived file; it carries no CC version field at all and never was. Corrected 2026-07-25. `latest_known` (the highest CC version ork's adoption covers — distinct from `latest`, the support-window head; they diverge while a manual_override freezes the floor) stamps LATEST_KNOWN_CC, the version-check adoption-nudge threshold. Updated by .github/workflows/cc-support-window-bump.yml.
